27. According to my understanding, the rules and regulations, codes of practice and requirements, to FH/ HR Systems and submissions of SDNs include:

(i) Codes of Practice (Amended) (Minimum Fire Service Installations and Equipment) and (Inspection and Testing of Installations and Equipment) published by the FSD in August 1982, Part III paragraphs 15-34;

(ii) Codes of Practice for Minimum Fire Service Installations and Equipment and Inspection and Testing of Installations and Equipment published by the FSD in 2022, particular paragraphs 2.14 and 5.14, and Appendices 5 and 9; and

(iii) FSD Circular Letter No. 1/2021 of 15th January 2021.

Question 8.1

28. My understanding was that PC&E would need to renovate the fire services water tanks of the 8 buildings in Wang Fuk Court. For this purpose, the fire services water tanks would have to be emptied, and the FH / HR System suspended. I do not know if the need to renovate the existing fire services water tanks stems from the annual inspection result conducted by Victory Fire. My understanding from PC&E is that the renovation of the water tanks was part of the tender of the Wang Fuk Court Renovation so had to be carried out. Further, my understanding was that the responsibility for works to concrete water tanks would fall within the scope of the construction side, instead of FSI contractors such as China Status.

Question 8.2

29. The explanation given by China Status to the FSD for shutting down the FH / HR System for all 8 buildings in Wang Fuk Court was that there was water leakage to the water tanks and repairs were needed.

Question 8.3

30.
